ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) background with approximately 25-30% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white mottling and flecking concentrated along the interior margins near the median notch and extending toward the lobe tips, with sparse speckling across the central dark fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a narrow vertex; estimated internal angle between 30 and 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying amplitudes along both lobes; prominent jagged indentations visible on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading and trailing margins, tapering to sharp, upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, raised circular pixels at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, bright linear pixel disruption oriented diagonally on the inner quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular tissue loss and jagged indentations on the trailing edge of the left lobe; visible light-colored barnacle clusters at both lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique density of white punctate marks localized along the lower-right interior margin of the fluke near the peduncle junction.
